blocks.prompt: 5. The \(n\)th term of the sequence \(2, 0, -2, -4, \ldots\) and the \(n\)th term of the sequence \(-22, -20, -18, -16, \ldots\) are equal, find the value of \(n\).
blocks.explanation:
Yahan do alag sequences hain. Pehli 2 se shuru ho kar neeche ja rahi hai, doosri \(-22\) se shuru ho kar oopar aa rahi hai, is liye kisi jagah dono ek doosre se milengi.
Humein woh position \(n\) find karni hai jahan dono ka term barabar ho.
Plan: dono ka \(n\)th term \(dn + c\) shakal mein nikalenge (Question 4 ki tarah), dono ko barabar rakhenge, aur ek simple equation se \(n\) nikalenge.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(2, 0, -2, -4, \ldots\) aur \(-22, -20, -18, -16, \ldots\); dono ke \(n\)th terms barabar hain.
Humein find karna hai: \(n\) ki value.
Tareeqa: Dono ke \(n\)th terms \(dn + c\) shakal mein likh kar barabar rakhenge aur \(n\) ke liye linear equation solve karenge. Doosri sequence ke terms ko \(b_n\) kahenge taake dono mix na hon.

Pehli sequence ka \(n\)th term
\[d = 0 - 2 = -2\]
\[-2(1) + c = 2 \Rightarrow c = 4\]
\[a_n = 4 - 2n\]
Kyun: Pehli sequence har dafa 2 ghatti hai, is liye \(d = -2\). \(n = 1\) par pehla term 2 aana chahiye, is se \(c = 4\) mila. Check: \(n = 3\) par \(4 - 6 = -2\), sahi.

Doosri sequence ka \(n\)th term
\[d = -20 - (-22) = 2\]
\[2(1) + c = -22 \Rightarrow c = -24\]
\[b_n = 2n - 24\]
Kyun: Doosri sequence har dafa 2 barhti hai (\(-22\) se \(-20\)), is liye \(d = 2\). \(n = 1\) par \(-22\) chahiye: \(2 + c = -22\), to \(c = -24\).
Dhyan dein: \(-20 - (-22) = -20 + 22 = 2\); minus ke saath minus aaye to plus ban jata hai.

Dono ko barabar rakh kar solve karein
\[4 - 2n = 2n - 24\]
\[28 = 4n\]
\[n = 7\]
Kyun: "\(n\)th terms barabar hain" ka matlab hai \(a_n = b_n\). Dono taraf \(2n\) jama kiya aur 24 jama kiya taake \(n\) wale terms ek taraf aur numbers doosri taraf aa jayein: \(4 + 24 = 2n + 2n\), yani \(28 = 4n\). Phir 4 se divide.

Tasdeeq
\[a_7 = 4 - 14 = -10\]
\[b_7 = 14 - 24 = -10 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: \(n = 7\) par dono sequences ka term \(-10\) hai. Aap list barha kar bhi dekh sakte hain: pehli 2, 0, \(-2\), \(-4\), \(-6\), \(-8\), \(-10\); doosri \(-22, \ldots, -12, -10\). Dono ka 7th term \(-10\).
